stellenGefunden.description: True if an operative logistics or freight forwarding job was found, otherwise false.

anzahl.description: Number of job offers found. 1 if a job was found, 0 if no job was found.

stellenangebote.description: If a job was found, an array with exactly one job offer object. If no job was found, an empty array.

position.description: The job title, for example Berufskraftfahrer, LKW-Fahrer, Disponent, Lagerist.

beschreibung.description: Short summary of the job description with a focus on tasks and requirements, maximum 400 characters. If no description is available, 'Keine Beschreibung verfügbar'.
